text: or you can also do maybe ctrl + scroll wheel to change this?
resolution: The ctrl+scroll variant of the camera tilt ask, shipped together with req_2710 in 8e42779fc: in the map editor viewport ctrl+wheel now tilts the iso camera 3° per notch (wheel up climbs toward a plan view, wheel down levels toward the horizon) while plain wheel keeps the existing zoom-to-cursor; vertical middle-drag does the same tilt continuously. Pitch is clamped 12°-80° in IsoStage so picking, painting and the ghost overlay projection stay stable at every angle. TS-only change, hot reload picks it up.
